acceptanceCriteria: The Go plugin skips directories named `testdata` (and their descendants) when building units, matching the go tool's rule.
A changed file under a `testdata/` directory no longer produces a `NO_SELECTABLE_TEST` unknown; the owning non-testdata package is still traced as before.
`corvint affected --base 062b0151` reports the same selected set as before the change.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the V1-0187 review (NIT 3). The Go plugin of `internal/liveverify/affected` records `testdata/` directories as Go units although the go tool ignores them. With AFP-V0-020 a changed `testdata/` directory can be reported as a changed untested Go package in `plan.unknown`, so the plan turns UNKNOWN for a fixture-only edit.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-23 by PR #119 (merge 216ffa4). Criterion 1: the Go plugin drops testdata directories relative to the owning module, as the go tool does; TestTestdataIsFixtureDataNotAPackage_AFPV0008 fails on the base plugin and passes. Criterion 2: a fixture edit reports UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH instead of NO_SELECTABLE_TEST and a source edit still selects its package test (same test; TestWorkspaceModuleBelowTestdataIsObserved_AFPV0008 covers a workspace module below testdata). Criterion 3: replay of corvint affected --base 062b0151 on a clean tree at b195af3 gives the same 65 selected units, witnesses and unknowns before and after; only one fixture unit leaves plan.excluded (BUILD-LOG entry 2026-09-23 V1-0203). Binding sealed at .corvint/changes/785272275bdfd4aea814be1d3adf780d8cf43411.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 of golang.go, golang_test.go, affected-plan-v0.md and the sealed CEM on main. AFP-V0-008 accepted text was amended; the owner's merge of PR #119 is its human review. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: affected: Go plugin indexes `testdata/` directories, which surface as NO_SELECTABLE_TEST noise
